CONTROLS & SETUP
motion: unknown
1.0
ROLL BUTTONS
On, the LR and RR buttons roll the ship: hold one for the knife edge, tap it twice for a barrel roll that way. Off, the old gesture instead -- double-tap the screen on the side you want, and hold the second tap to stay on edge.
PAINT TO LOCK
On, a target locks only while the crosshair is actually on it. Off, anything within a quarter of the screen paints, which plays as an auto-lock.
INVERT LEFT/RIGHT INVERT UP/DOWN
MUTE MUSIC CRT GLOW
TAP or hold anywhere — machine gun.
DOUBLE TAP — barrel roll, which takes the ship sideways. Tap the right of the screen to go right, the left to go left.
DOUBLE TAP AND HOLD — stay on edge while you hold, same side rule. Lift to come level.
Tap on the picture, not on the buttons — the corner they sit in does not pass taps through. Anywhere above them counts.
❯❯❯ is the boost. Hold it; the lit chevrons are what is left in the tank.
gamepad: none
